# Oban Plugins Lazarus v0.1.1 - Table of Contents

> Oban plugin that rescues orphaned jobs stuck in executing state, reviving single-attempt jobs that would otherwise be discarded.

## Pages

- [Oban.Plugins.Lazarus](https://oban-plugins-lazarus.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [Oban.Plugins.Lazarus](https://oban-plugins-lazarus.hexdocs.pm/Oban.Plugins.Lazarus.md): Naively transition jobs stuck `executing` back to `available`.
